title: What the Road Carries

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: Two slates under one arm, both turned to the sleeve; the road carries and reads neither. A hair-thin thaw where no broom goes; the river softens at one edge under its skin. Both are weather, and weather keeps no account.
epigraph.attribution: A saying of the Low Kiln bucket-round, in the month of Silt

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of four hundred and twenty-nine to four hundred and thirty-one days, six months and two hundred and forty-nine to two hundred and fifty-one days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody; count 428 exact at the opening on answer 432, closing at 431 exact on answer 438. The old life rides the surgeon's register alone: no present-tense break is spent in this chapter and no \memory{} tag is used, the white room, the page over the speakers and the hands that stayed in the field going on gathering interest from Chapter 113. No departure from the boy's eyes: the Debt Loft is a sound from above and behind, the back room a shape and a dust, the Drawing a room seen and not entered, the out-of-line landing a report brought up the yard and never a sighting. Silt 5, 6 and 7 are three ordinary tending days, each with its own dated \daymark and two full scenes of at least eight hundred words; there is no market, no Cross, no bell, no Account-day, no called collector and no runner on any of them, and nothing from the third reading or the two market sightings of Ilmen 30 crosses under the roof as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer. The month goes on without a boundary drawn and neither of the district's two habits of naming its months is set right or left. The neighbour's near-reaching at the loaf shelf on Silt 3 stays on its own place, is not repeated on an unearned day and is not made a custom, a sixth shaping, a witness, a reader or a payer. The house takes up its grammar as though nothing had turned. The runner's reaching advances on Silt 6 — a word at the well that the woman who carries Berr Clay's slate has begun carrying a second, narrower slate edge-on under her arm with its writing turned the same way, and no figure off either — filed as a report and a shape, advanced and NOT paid; the thaw nobody will own advances on Silt 7 — the grey called the thaw a hair less distinct where no broom has gone and the river's skin softer at one edge — found where put and called weather, advanced and NOT paid. Six honest answers 433 through 438 stand on the sixth place, two to each day, and not one is a doctrine. Six hearings stand beside and never among with the seventh empty and the Drawing's knock outside; nine record-first hands and nine stoppings stand with no tenth; seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule; three readings of the year stand behind one unsigned figure, three being three and not one account, the figure read still not the figure paid; the two sightings stay on separate trays with no eighth of either. Silt 10 (Day 434), the month's first reading and the year's fourth, waits three mornings beyond the close as a date and is not brought.
places: the flat stone by the well

scenes.title: The Fifth Morning of Silt
scenes.synopsis: First entry, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first dated \daymark{429}{Silt 5, Y.H. 814, Fifthday}: the small hours open on the hand laid flat on the fold on answer 432 and the count exact at 428, six months and two hundred and forty-eight days told by nobody, with no next hand in the room; then first grey, the carrying-down of the nineteen steps at the half-pace from every open slate, and the morning work of an ordinary Fifthday. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail at the hearth before the basket, Tarn at the kindling and flagstones, Jorra Vail at the wheel-shed edge; Garl Vail in objects only (salt-stiff coat, hollow wheel-seat, clean dark line with its finer grey, the twice-mended pot, the unforged collector sentence). Ilva offstage with her count still in wood, Hessa's single slate unread up the road and Berr up the clay road with the box locked and the key gone up in a coat pocket; no market, Cross, bell, reading, runner or collector; the neighbour's near-reaching of Silt 3 found where put and not repeated; no sixth shaping, seventh hearing, tenth hand, eleventh arithmetic or eighth opening, and no slate opened within reach of the basket. Dramatic purpose: the surgeon takes the body in its old order — one stiff brown-edged barley crust gone past leather into old horn two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool, the fold found where put in the empty place and still a finding and not a placing, the thread stiff in the dry kiln heat and unwiped because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the small bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back as at the end of a line written out for it, the Afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — and the infant's three wants quarrel without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning, the quarrel the work (T060/T086/T097). A detail of the horn-hard crust and the cold joint brings one untagged past-tense fragment of the surgeon's register, no present-tense break, no \memory{} tag, the old life riding the register alone (T004). Sella's whole hearth grammar holds at the morning: fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with the back of a broken pot, intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, finger along the top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal tally stays unread, lips on a two-gapped row, one glance at the cold clay jar with the hand shut half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, the twice-mended pot lifted thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire and never to a person, repair held apart from restoration, dressed grain turned under wool with no figure or handful, pot rim set two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed; the widow's mark hangs where it hangs, seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule (T058/T079/T100). Tarn keeps six pieces in the worn thumb-mark where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, the small knife at the very edge of its sill, his hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach; he tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count* once in the tone of a man stating the weather, found where put and not a habit, the ear-sentence stopped at the word that would call the loan, the Seed 16 breath unspent, the loan uncalled in a term already ended (T036/T076/T006). Jorra comes through the finger's-width door with meal-fine grey slate dust past the bent finger and white in a fist-crease, parts dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person, knows the full note three turns ahead and withholds it from any High Kiln master who would call it early; *he's not Vail* sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062). Answer 433 comes out and is filed on the sixth place; count reaches 429 exact, six months and two hundred and forty-nine days, told by nobody; he stands no number up as a threshold, doctrine or figure, for paper is not a payer (T071/T072).

scenes.title: What the Fifth Left
scenes.synopsis: Second entry, no new dated heading: Silt 5 afternoon through the going of the light and the small hours closing the day, with answer 434 filed and the count at 429 exact, six months and two hundred and forty-nine days told by nobody. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons only at the ordinary yard grammar; Ilva offstage with her strip in her sleeve and her ninth hand nine; Hessa's slate unread up the road, Berr gone up the clay road with the third subtraction locked inside, the soft-cuffed clerk still reported at the out-of-line landing and never a sighting, a witness or a tenth hand. The offered figure, the well-asking, the second man's turned slate and direction, the clerk's entered figure, the fifth shaping, the three likenesses of Slate Row and the neighbour's near-reaching of Silt 3 stay found where put and are not repeated on a day that earned only its fifth; no collector comes up or down the clay road and Silt 10 waits three mornings off as a date. Day already dated in Scene 1. Dramatic purpose: the boy takes the yard's small sounds first because they do not lie and the large ones are mostly weather — pail down on the flat stone with its flat knock, rope settling into its knot with the cold-stiffened rasp, barley wall to wall without a number, a loaf pushed a finger's width along a board and stopped with nobody calling the stopping a figure — and takes each apart by fist, eye, mouth and the half-beat in the gap, giving the gap no intention, for an intention wants a payer where none stands (T061/T082). He goes once around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, once and not twice, widest at the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come back (T098, T009/T013/T092). The trough keeps the gone pan's shallow round print on a place of its own, not laid across the loaf's stopping or the ridge; at the Vail corner the clean dark line keeps its finer grey called the thaw beside the called-gone grey of the ridge with a finger between, a thing left in place not forgiven; the air off the river is less cold at one edge where the low note runs nearer under the winter skin, found where put, called weather, not looked twice, not a fourth covering, sign, payment or custom (T083/T085/T092 held, T009/T013/T092). Costs arrive as directions and go away as weather and leave no entry: a fist opens toward the well, looks at the light, shuts and goes back into a sleeve, arriving nowhere; a woman sent for a pot's cost is sent to the pot and gets a note and not a price; the figure read over the covered grain does not know what the grain cost and the ink-neat space between figure and price has no signature (T077). Going of the light: Sella comes to the hearth before the basket, the whole grammar returns and the household straightens around the order; widow's mark untouched because a going of the light is not an opening and seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule; the keeping at the fold found where put with no second fold, third crust, name, gift, payment or payer; under the boards the carried fire gives four low pulls and the silence where the fifth should have stood, its payer without a name for four hundred and twenty-nine days; nobody lifts the floor and nobody supplies the pull (T058/T079, T097, T088). Small hours: the towel comes out at the head of the bed as instruments do when a case is done; the surgeon's exactness and the infant's want stand side by side, neither buys the other; answer 434 filed, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, laid across neither the neighbour's near-reaching nor any other kept thing (T061/T082, T071/T072).

scenes.title: The Sixth Morning of Silt
scenes.synopsis: Third entry and second dated \daymark{430}{Silt 6, Y.H. 814, Sixthday}: the small hours open on the hand laid down on answer 434 and the count exact at 429, six months and two hundred and forty-nine days told by nobody; then first grey, the carrying-down and the morning of an ordinary Sixthday. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail at the hearth before the basket, Tarn at the kindling, Jorra Vail at the wheel-shed edge; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons at the yard grammar; Hessa's single slate still unread up the road before the day's report comes up at the well, Ilva offstage, Berr's box locked up the road, the clerk's entered figure a report and not a sighting; no market, Cross, bell, Account-day, called collector or runner; day already dated in no earlier scene. New day, new date, no recap; nothing from Silt 5 crosses under the roof as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer. Dramatic purpose: the body is inventoried in the old order and the infant's three wants quarrel without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning (T060/T086/T097). The morning's honest work is given its exact texture — tallow and woodsmoke, wet wool, the pot board, the half-beat at the setting, the dressed grain turned and covered, a fist of barley judged by the hand that carries it — and the surgeon reads the house by what it will not say rather than by what it will not survive. Sella's fire-before-basket grammar holds at the morning, ahead of the basket in every order; the widow's mark is untouched because a Sixthday morning is not an opening, and seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule (T058/T079). Tarn keeps six in the worn thumb-mark where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, the small knife at the edge of its sill, his hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach; *Six counted. The next I don't count* is found where put and not made a habit, not a tenth stopping, payment, hearing or rule; the ear-sentence stays stopped at the word that would call the loan, the Seed 16 breath unspent, his valuable ear exposure rather than safety in a term already ended (T036/T076/T006). Jorra comes through with grey slate dust ground meal-small past the bent finger, parts dusty from clean as clot from vessel, moves the damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence and takes the cold out of his fingertip without leaving the extra holding of Ash 26 a second time; the promise under the wheel-shed stays neither given nor withdrawn and *he's not Vail* stays sealed (T035/T031/T062). Answer 435 is filed; count reaches 430 exact, six months and two hundred and fifty days told by nobody; the carried fire's fifth is unpaid and Garl's name unspoken the same number, the two counts standing side by side without becoming one (T071/T072, T088).

scenes.title: What the Sixth Left
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry, no new dated heading: Silt 6 afternoon through the going of the light and the small hours closing the day, with answer 436 filed and the count at 430 exact, six months and two hundred and fifty days told by nobody. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons at the yard well and rail; the woman who carries the slate is not on stage, has no interior, no name, no errand and no witness's standing; Ilva, Hessa, Berr and the clerk offstage with their keepings found where put; day already dated in Scene 3. Dramatic purpose: **the chapter's one meaningful change (advanced and NOT paid; T080 with T090/T102).** In the afternoon a word comes up at the yard well, from mouth to mouth among the bucket-round with no body standing under it, that the woman who carries Berr Clay's slate has begun carrying a second, narrower slate edge-on under her arm, its writing turned the same way toward her sleeve; no figure comes off either slate, her hand goes to the slates before her eyes go to the yard and her mouth after both, the half-beat lying in the gap. It is a report and not a sighting, the runner not made a reader, no name spoken over the second slate, no room entered, no threshold crossed and no slate opened within reach of the basket. The boy takes its order by the place of each part — hand to slate, eye to the yard, mouth after both, the half-beat standing in the gap — and files the second slate on a place of its own beside Hessa's eighth record-first hand, Ilva's offered figure and its return, the clerk's entered figure and the three likenesses of Slate Row, with a finger between every pair: not a reader made, not a ninth or tenth hand, not a witness, not a sale, not a sixth shaping, not a custom and not the calling of the loan (T080/T090/T102). He does not lay it across the twelve arithmetics of Y.H. 813, the three readings gone up the road behind one unsigned figure, the printed one in twelve, the fifth shaping of the well-saying, the neighbour's near-reaching of Silt 3 or the two market sightings; those keep their own places with a finger between, and the crossing stays a report at the well and is not repeated on an unearned seventh day (T015/T041/T047 held, T097 held, T050/T051 held). The rest of the afternoon keeps its grammar: seven walked-around places once and not twice, widest at the returning-line place; the trough's round print on its own place; the two unswept lines at the Vail corner with a finger between, the softening at the river's skin found where put and called weather, not made a sign and not looked twice; a fist arriving nowhere; a woman sent to a pot getting a note and not a price (T098, T009/T013/T092, T083/T085/T092 held, T077). Going of the light: the whole hearth grammar returns and closes the day; widow's mark untouched, keeping at the fold found where put and not made again, four low pulls under the floor and the fifth not supplied (T058/T079, T097, T088). Small hours: answer 436 filed on the sixth place, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, laid across neither the reported second slate nor any other kept thing; surgeon's register and infant's want side by side, second louder, neither winning (T061/T082, T071/T072).

scenes.title: The Seventh Morning of Silt
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry and third dated \daymark{431}{Silt 7, Y.H. 814, Seventhday}: the small hours open on the hand laid down on answer 436 and the count exact at 430, six months and two hundred and fifty days told by nobody; then first grey and the morning of an ordinary Seventhday. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn at the kindling, Jorra Vail at the wheel-shed edge; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons at the yard grammar. No market, Cross, bell, Account-day, called collector or runner. Nothing from Silt 6's reported second slate crosses under the roof as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer; the report is not told again on a day that has earned only its seventh. New day, new date, no recap. Dramatic purpose: the body is inventoried in the old order — crust gone into old horn with its hair-lifted corner, fold found where put and still a finding, thread stiff and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of its own instruction, Afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — and the infant's three wants quarrel without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning, the quarrel the work (T060/T086/T097). The morning's honest work in its exact texture: tallow and woodsmoke, wet wool, the pot board, the half-beat at the setting, the dressed grain turned under wool and covered, a fist of barley weighed in the hand and set back without a number; the surgeon reads a thing ceasing and not a thing mended. Sella's whole grammar holds ahead of the basket in every order; the widow's mark hangs where it hangs, seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule, and no eighth comes due on a Seventhday that has earned only its seventh (T058/T079). Tarn's sentence is found where put and not made a habit, not a tenth stopping, payment or rule, the loan uncalled in a term already ended and his valuable ear exposure and not safety; Jorra's bent finger takes the cold out of the damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, moves the tongue a hair's breadth and comes out without leaving the extra holding of Ash 26 a second time; the two quiet men under one roof stay unjoined (T036/T076/T006, T035/T031/T062). Answer 437 is filed; count reaches 431 exact, six months and two hundred and fifty-one days told by nobody; the fire's fifth is unpaid and Garl's name unspoken the same number, and he stands no number up as a threshold, doctrine or figure, for a number counted is a number with air around it and air buys no warmth (T071/T072, T088).

scenes.title: What the Seventh Left
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Silt 7 afternoon through the going of the light and the small hours closing the chapter, with answer 438 filed and the count at 431 exact, six months and two hundred and fifty-one days told by nobody. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl Vail in objects. Tarn, Jorra offstage at kindling and wheel-shed with their keepings found where put; Ilva offstage with strip unread and ninth hand nine; Hessa's reported second slate on its own place and her first slate unread up the road, her eighth hand eighth; Berr up the clay road with the box locked and the key gone up in a coat pocket; the soft-cuffed clerk's inward slate and entered figure reported at the out-of-line landing; the neighbour's near-joining of shelf and fold from Silt 3 filed on its own place, not repeated on an unearned day; the two sightings on separate trays with no eighth of either. Walk-ons only at the yard grammar. No second well-telling, no repetition of the reported second slate, no present-tense break and no \memory{} tag; no sixth hearing, tenth hand, tenth stopping, eighth opening, sixth shaping, eleventh arithmetic, signature, payer, witness or reader; day already dated in Scene 5. Dramatic purpose: **the second advance, advanced and NOT paid (T083/T085/T092 with T009/T013/T092).** At the Vail corner the clean dark line keeps its finer grey called the thaw a hair less distinct along one stretch where no broom has gone in two years, thickened in the dry cold with the faint sour tang of Ash coming up off it; the air off the river is less cold at one edge where the low note of water over water runs nearer under its skin, the tang thinner there. He finds both where put, does not look twice, calls them weather — not a sign, not a fourth covering, not a fourth likeness, not a sixth shaping, not a payment, with no hand or payer under them and not made again; Sella tells the fire it is the thaw and does not tell the basket. The two greys at the corner keep a finger between, the called-gone beside the left-in-place, and a thing left in place is not a thing forgiven. The rest of the yard grammar holds: seven walked-around places once and not twice, the trough's round print on its own place, costs arriving as directions and going away as weather, a fist arriving nowhere, a note that is not a price, a figure that does not know what the covered grain cost with the ink-neat space unsigned (T098, T009/T013/T092, T077). Going of the light: Sella's whole grammar returns and closes the day — her hands never still when they have nothing to do, counting spoons, nails and the breaths of a child nobody numbers and coming back to the hairline at the wire; widow's mark hanging where it hangs; pot thumb-first with both proverbs to pot and fire and never to a person; dressed grain turned under wool, covered and unfigured; pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with its half-beat and no look toward the bed; the fold righted at his ear without a look at his face and with no second fold; the keeping at the fold found where put and still a finding (T058/T079/T100, T060/T086/T097). Small hours: the towel comes out at the head of the bed as instruments do when a case is done; six hearings stand beside and never among with the seventh place empty and the Drawing's knock outside; the heard bell stands beside the told bell with both gaps in their own squares, three counts in three places staying three; nine record-first hands and nine stoppings with no tenth; seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule; three readings of the year stand behind one unsigned figure, three being three and not one account, the twelve not laid across the three, no signature and no doctrine out of three, Silt 10 (Day 434), the month's first reading and the year's fourth, waiting three mornings off as a date and not brought (T061/T082, T078, T015/T041/T047, T071/T072). Offstage keepings found where put and not spent: the reported second slate of Silt 6 on its own place; the offered figure and its return beside the ninth hand and the fifth shaping; the well-asking, the second man's turned slate and direction, the first man's face, the clerk's entered figure, the three likenesses of Slate Row, the neighbour's near-reaching, the two sightings on separate trays, the green and the shape, the burned slate at five and the four ownerless directions each with a finger between every pair (T080/T090/T102 held, T050/T051 with T033/T034 held, T065/T095 held). The surgeon's exactness and the infant's want stand side by side, both true, the second louder, neither winning, the quarrel the work; the unsent call to Nina is not paid again (T020 held). Answer 438 is filed; six honest answers 433 through 438 stand on the sixth place, two to each day, and not one is a doctrine; count 431 exact, six months and two hundred and fifty-one days told by nobody; the fire's fifth unpaid and Garl's name unspoken the same number.
